g.text: One meromorphic wave per fixed C. Elliptic waves require b² = 16a in the general KS operator.
C = −18 and −8 are the two degenerations; only the interval between them has Δ > 0.
Lattice of the full twisted period group Γ · Real invariants do not alone imply a bounded real profile.
